name: Swipe Row
description: Swipeable list row that slides aside to reveal action buttons, with rubber-band drag, flick momentum, and a full swipe that commits the primary action and collapses the row.
contents: Row surface holding any children, with a hidden accessible toggle button
Action drawer with one button per action, the first being the primary action
behavior: Pointer drag past a 10px threshold reveals actions with rubber-band resistance
Flick velocity or drag distance decides whether the drawer snaps open or closed
Dragging past the commit point expands the primary action and releasing commits it
Committed row slides out, then collapses its height and fades before onCommit fires
Keyboard: arrow key toggles drawer, Escape closes, Delete or Backspace commits primary when open
Reduced motion uses short eased tweens instead of springs
Optional vibration on touch when the commit point is reached
editableByProps: Row content through children and the accessible label
Actions: count, labels, icons, per-action colors, callbacks
Colors for row, drawer, primary action and text
Row height, corner radius, action button width
Swipe direction, drag resistance, snap bounce, commit threshold, full swipe on or off
Collapse duration, disabled state, controlled open state, haptics

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the default primary action icon
needsCodeEdit.where: HugeiconsIcon Delete02Icon in the primary motion.button
text-[11px] span classes inside the action buttons
SPRING_UI constant and the settle function

fixed: Client component using pointer events and a ResizeObserver
Registers window pointermove, pointerup and pointercancel listeners during a drag
First action in the actions array is always the primary, full-swipe action
Actions with dismiss true also commit and collapse the row
Only left or right direction, horizontal swipe only; vertical movement scrolls the page
Row collapse relies on the parent letting the row height and margin transition
Keyboard toggle button is visually hidden until focused
Vibration only on touch pointers where supported
